ائتلفا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَلَفَا (iʔtalafā) /iʔ.ta.la.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# اِئْتَلِفَا (iʔtalifā) /iʔ.ta.li.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
